probeKey.label: Run probes shortcut
probeKey.description: Each press runs every probe once and logs its lines. Default F5.

intervalSeconds.label: Seconds between runs
intervalSeconds.description: How often every probe runs on its own.

cursorSeconds.label: Seconds between cursor lines
cursorSeconds.description: How often the building cursor is logged between runs. 0 logs it only with the other probes.

boxHalfSize.label: Prop box half size (metres)
boxHalfSize.description: The props probe asks for the props in a box this far from you on every axis.

allowWrites.label: Allow writes (copied world only)
allowWrites.description: Off: the probe only reads. On: each run you start with the shortcut or the button writes one field of one component the game lets mods write, then writes the old value back. Use a copied world.

writeComponent.label: Component to write
writeComponent.description: Empty: the first component the catalog marks writable that has an entity. Or a name such as keen::ecs::Health.
